recognition.heading: The Prophet of THE LORD, **honoured**
recognition.summary: Received at the airport in Bogotá with a police escort, welcomed with the flag of the city, and presented with a ceremonial golden key.

photos.alt: The Prophet receiving a ceremonial golden key in a presentation case, surrounded by people filming.
photos.title: A ceremonial key
photos.caption: Presented with a golden key inscribed “Bendito el que viene en el nombre de Jehová” (Psalm 118:26).

photos.alt: The Prophet walking through the airport arrivals hall, escorted by uniformed police officers.
photos.title: Escorted on arrival
photos.caption: Received at the airport with a police escort.

photos.alt: The Prophet and his hosts holding up the yellow and red flag of Bogotá in the airport.
photos.title: The flag of Bogotá
photos.caption: Welcomed with the flag of the city.

photos.alt: Hosts presenting the Prophet with gifts, beside a sign welcoming him to Bogotá.
photos.title: Gifts of welcome
photos.caption: Gifts presented by his hosts on arrival.

photos.alt: The Prophet speaking and holding a plaque, standing between four police officers.
photos.title: A plaque, among the police
photos.caption: Holding a plaque, standing with officers of the police.
